diagnosis: Customer reports a roughly one-hour webhook delivery gap yesterday affecting about forty events. Per kb-0015, failed deliveries retry six times over roughly an hour, after which events remain available for manual replay for seven days, so the missed events should still be within the replay window.
reply: Thanks for flagging this. When a webhook delivery fails, our system retries it six times over roughly an hour; if those retries don't succeed, the event isn't lost—it remains available for manual replay for seven days. Since the delivery gap you're describing happened yesterday, the roughly forty missed events should still be within that seven-day replay window and can be resent. You can trigger the replay from the webhooks section of your dashboard, or let us know the event range and we'll help you locate them.
